newsitem.title: USA: Escapee from Missouri mental hospital arrested in N.Y.
newsitem.headline: Escapee from Missouri mental hospital arrested in N.Y.

text.p: An escapee from a Missouri mental hospital who was committed for the murder of his wife, was arrested early Sunday in New York after his story was featured on a television show.

Lloyd Earl Grass, 48, who escaped from a Warren County, Missouri, mental facility near St. Louis in August 1996 was apprehended without incident at a private home in the Astoria section in the city's borough of Queens without incident, a Federal Bureau of Investigation spokesman said.

"The arrest came about as a result of his case being featured on the television programme America's Most Wanted,' Saturday evening. Based on tips we received after the programme, agents and detectives from the FBI/New York Police Department Joint Fugitive Task Force arrested the man ... ," the spokesman said.
Grass had been at the mental hospital ever since the stabbing death of his wife, Sheri in October 1992.
